title: PowerContext · 模型调用
description: 按所选时间范围查看模型调用次数、结果、耗时、HTTP 状态和逐次日志。进程累计值受服务重启影响；调用链是否保存需单独核对。

list.name: capability
list.label: 模型能力
list.query: 生成模型 : generation,向量模型 : embedding

list.name: execution
list.label: 执行进程
list.query: 服务主进程 : parent,后台子进程 : worker

options.content: **先看调用规模、结果和耗时。** 点击曲线点可查看前后 5 分钟日志；展开日志后可打开调用链。调用次数按最终模型操作计算；HTTP 状态码按每次响应头计算，重试会让二者数量不同。服务主进程与后台子进程分别显示。

panels.title: 调用次数 · 时间范围 / 累计
panels.description: “时间范围”是所选区间内的估算调用次数；“累计”从当前服务进程启动后累计，重启归零。调用次数按最终模型操作计算。

panels.title: 调用结果比例
panels.description: 按最终模型操作计算成功、失败和取消比例。取消不等于失败；没有调用时保持未知。

targets.expr: ((sum(increase(powercontext_server_provider_operations_total{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance",provider=~"$provider",capability=~"$capability",execution=~"$execution",outcome="success"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(increase(powercontext_server_provider_operations_total{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance",provider=~"$provider",capability=~"$capability",execution=~"$execution"}[$__range]))) and on() (sum(increase(powercontext_server_provider_operations_total{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance",provider=~"$provider",capability=~"$capability",execution=~"$execution"}[$__range])) > 0) and on() (max(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"}) == 1) and on() (max(time() - timestamp(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"})) < 45)

((sum(increase(powercontext_server_provider_operations_total{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance",provider=~"$provider",capability=~"$capability",execution=~"$execution",outcome="failure"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(increase(powercontext_server_provider_operations_total{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance",provider=~"$provider",capability=~"$capability",execution=~"$execution"}[$__range]))) and on() (sum(increase(powercontext_server_provider_operations_total{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance",provider=~"$provider",capability=~"$capability",execution=~"$execution"}[$__range])) > 0) and on() (max(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"}) == 1) and on() (max(time() - timestamp(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"})) < 45)

((sum(increase(powercontext_server_provider_operations_total{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance",provider=~"$provider",capability=~"$capability",execution=~"$execution",outcome="cancelled"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(increase(powercontext_server_provider_operations_total{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance",provider=~"$provider",capability=~"$capability",execution=~"$execution"}[$__range]))) and on() (sum(increase(powercontext_server_provider_operations_total{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance",provider=~"$provider",capability=~"$capability",execution=~"$execution"}[$__range])) > 0) and on() (max(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"}) == 1) and on() (max(time() - timestamp(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"})) < 45)

panels.title: 调用耗时 P50 / P95
panels.description: 最终模型操作从开始到返回的完整耗时，包含重试、读取响应和校验输出。

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by(le) (increase(powercontext_server_provider_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance",provider=~"$provider",capability=~"$capability",execution=~"$execution"}[$__range]))) and on() (sum(increase(powercontext_server_provider_operation_duration_seconds_count{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance",provider=~"$provider",capability=~"$capability",execution=~"$execution"}[$__range])) > 0) and on() (max(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"}) == 1) and on() (max(time() - timestamp(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"})) < 45)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le) (increase(powercontext_server_provider_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance",provider=~"$provider",capability=~"$capability",execution=~"$execution"}[$__range]))) and on() (sum(increase(powercontext_server_provider_operation_duration_seconds_count{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance",provider=~"$provider",capability=~"$capability",execution=~"$execution"}[$__range])) > 0) and on() (max(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"}) == 1) and on() (max(time() - timestamp(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"})) < 45)

panels.title: 调用趋势 · 成功、失败、服务主进程与后台子进程
调用量 · 成功 / 失败 / 取消
panels.description: 每个时间段的最终模型操作数量。取消不是失败；重试会产生多次 HTTP 尝试，但不一定产生多次最终操作。

targets.expr: sum by(role,instance,provider,capability) (increase(powercontext_server_provider_operations_total{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance",provider=~"$provider",capability=~"$capability",execution=~"$execution",outcome="success"}[$__rate_interval])) and on() (max(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"}) == 1) and on() (max(time() - timestamp(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"})) < 45)

sum by(role,instance,provider,capability) (increase(powercontext_server_provider_operations_total{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance",provider=~"$provider",capability=~"$capability",execution=~"$execution",outcome="failure"}[$__rate_interval])) and on() (max(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"}) == 1) and on() (max(time() - timestamp(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"})) < 45)

sum by(role,instance,provider,capability) (increase(powercontext_server_provider_operations_total{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance",provider=~"$provider",capability=~"$capability",execution=~"$execution",outcome="cancelled"}[$__rate_interval])) and on() (max(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"}) == 1) and on() (max(time() - timestamp(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"})) < 45)

panels.title: 调用量 · 服务主进程 / 后台子进程
panels.description: 同一模型操作按执行进程拆分。后台子进程的调用在服务主进程收到回传后才计入。

targets.expr: sum by(role,instance,provider,capability) (increase(powercontext_server_provider_operations_total{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance",provider=~"$provider",capability=~"$capability",execution=~"$execution",execution="parent"}[$__rate_interval])) and on() (max(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"}) == 1) and on() (max(time() - timestamp(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"})) < 45)

sum by(role,instance,provider,capability) (increase(powercontext_server_provider_operations_total{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance",provider=~"$provider",capability=~"$capability",execution=~"$execution",execution="worker"}[$__rate_interval])) and on() (max(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"}) == 1) and on() (max(time() - timestamp(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"})) < 45)

panels.title: 调用耗时 P50 / P95
panels.description: 最终模型操作的耗时趋势。日志会显示每一条调用的实际耗时。

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by(role,instance,provider,capability,le) (increase(powercontext_server_provider_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance",provider=~"$provider",capability=~"$capability",execution=~"$execution"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on(role,instance,provider,capability) (sum by(role,instance,provider,capability) (increase(powercontext_server_provider_operation_duration_seconds_count{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance",provider=~"$provider",capability=~"$capability",execution=~"$execution"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0) and on() (max(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"}) == 1) and on() (max(time() - timestamp(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"})) < 45)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(role,instance,provider,capability,le) (increase(powercontext_server_provider_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance",provider=~"$provider",capability=~"$capability",execution=~"$execution"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on(role,instance,provider,capability) (sum by(role,instance,provider,capability) (increase(powercontext_server_provider_operation_duration_seconds_count{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance",provider=~"$provider",capability=~"$capability",execution=~"$execution"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0) and on() (max(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"}) == 1) and on() (max(time() - timestamp(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"})) < 45)

panels.title: HTTP 状态码 · 请求量
panels.description: 模型服务商实际返回的 HTTP 响应头。超时或连接失败可能没有状态码；SDK 重试会增加尝试次数。

panels.title: 采集完整性 · 按需展开
后台子进程回报覆盖率
panels.description: 后台子进程完成调用后，服务主进程实际收到回传的比例。它不是模型成功率；仍在运行的子进程尚未回传，无调用时也不能据此判断模型健康。

targets.expr: (sum(increase(powercontext_server_provider_worker_reports_total{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance",outcome="received"}[$__range])) / sum(increase(powercontext_server_provider_worker_reports_total{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))) and on() (sum(increase(powercontext_server_provider_worker_reports_total{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) > 0) and on() (max(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"}) == 1) and on() (max(time() - timestamp(up{job="powercontext",role=~"$role",instance=~"$instance"})) < 45)
